title: Ironcrown
aesthetic: heroic power metal played on REAL sampled instruments (soundfont/GM): distortion & overdrive guitars, picked electric bass, a harpsichord for the neoclassical runs, string ensemble, and choir — Helloween / Blind Guardian / Rhapsody energy, tracked rather than chip-synthed. Drums are the numpy kit (soundfont has no percussion channel).
_palette_note: Every pitched voice is engine=soundfont (real multisamples). GM programs: 30 Distortion Gtr, 29 Overdrive Gtr, 34 Electric Bass (pick), 6 Harpsichord, 48 String Ensemble, 52 Choir Aahs. Filter/wave/vibrato params don't apply to soundfont; expression comes from the samples plus buffer delay/reverb. 'release' extends the ring-out tail; short on the guitars/bass for tight chugs, long on strings/choir.
_motifs_note: anthem is the chorus hook: a full 16-beat question+answer sentence over i-VI-III-VII (Em-C-G-D). The antecedent (slice 0-8) rises and is left open; the consequent (slice 8-15) climbs to a NEW high A5 the antecedent never touched, then resolves down to the tonic E5. verse is the B-material: its OWN lower, tighter, marching melody over i-VII-VI-V (Em-D-C-B), ending on the raised-7th dominant that pulls back home. fanfare is the neoclassical E-harmonic-minor shred cell (sixteenths, D# leading tone) for the intro call and the solo.
